content: This medication may cause dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision. The consumption of alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate these effects. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities that require alertness or clear vision until you are certain you can perform them safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary and clearly indicated. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your healthcare provider before breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. Check the labels of all your medications, such as allergy or cough-and-cold products, as they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Trimethobenzamide is used to treat nausea and vomiting that may occur after surgery or due to certain stomach or intestinal problems, such as gastroenteritis. The dosage is determined based on your medical condition, age, and response to treatment. Do not increase your dose, use this medication more frequently, or take it for a longer duration than prescribed. Common side effects may include diarrhea, headache, dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Before taking trimethobenzamide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems.
